summary: Graph 'Find account' search is mouse-only: results are role=listbox/option but the input has no combobox role, aria-expanded, aria-controls or aria-activedescendant; there is no arrow-key navigation; options only fire onMouseDown, and tabbing to them blurs the input, which closes the list. Keyboard and screen-reader users can't select a search result, which is the main non-pointer way to focus a node on the canvas.
fix: Rebuild on the existing <Combobox> primitive (src/components/ui/combobox.tsx), which already handles Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Escape and the full combobox ARIA, and render the rows through renderOption.

summary: The quality filter <PopoverContent> keeps its default role="menu" but contains only checkboxes (no menuitems). Screen readers announce an empty menu, and the popover's arrow-key roving and first-item focus find nothing. funding-confirmed-by-popover.tsx already handles the same case correctly with role="group".
fix: Pass role="group" and aria-label="Quality filter" to PopoverContent, and wrap each section in <div role="group" aria-labelledby> pointing at an id on its popover__section-heading (same pattern as funding-confirmed-by-popover.tsx:124-142).

summary: The 'Reset to default' / 'Show all' actions inside role="menu" popovers are raw <button class="popover__reset-btn"> elements, not menuitems. They're invalid menu children and arrow-key roving skips them (popover.tsx only roves [role=menuitem|menuitemradio]). Also at explore.tsx:1100 and :1144.
fix: Render them as <PopoverItem onClick=…> (with a quiet modifier class if the muted styling should stay). Delete .popover__reset-btn once nothing uses it.

summary: Icon-only buttons are hand-rolled <button aria-label> instead of <Button size="icon">, which breaks hard rule 8: the explore Sort trigger (explore.tsx:456), the quality filter trigger (quality-filters.tsx:275), the confirmer filter chrome variant (funding-confirmed-by-popover.tsx:112), the copy button (funding-receipt-detail-modal.tsx:597), the graph panel collapse (endorsement-graph.tsx:1033), the map expand button (cert-locations-map.tsx:255), the funding refresh button (activity-detail.tsx:423, 24px), and the endorsement close/remove/revoke buttons (new-endorsement-panel.tsx:178, :280; endorsement-row.tsx:62).
fix: Swap each one for <Button size="icon" variant="ghost|secondary" aria-label=…>. Keep only the positioning bits of the BEM classes (.explore__chrome-btn--icon, .cert-detail__map-expand-btn, .viz__panel-collapse, .endorsement-panel__close, .endorsement-multi-row__remove, .funding-form__recorded-refresh) and drop their duplicated size, hover and focus rules.

summary: `{href ? <Link>{body}</Link> : null}` drops the whole body (thumbnail, title, meta) when href is null. href is typed string|null, and CertListRow/ProjectListRow pass null whenever parseActivityUri/parseAtUri fails, so a record with an unparseable URI renders as a blank row with only the author column.
fix:
Fall back to a non-link wrapper: `href ? {body} :
{body}
` (same pattern home-feed-rows.tsx:750-756 uses).

summary: When an explore fetch fails, state is reset to EMPTY with no error flag, so explore-results.tsx:131/259 shows 'No activities match. Try a different filter…'. That blames the user's filters for a network or indexer failure and offers no retry.
fix: Add an `error` field to the hook state on catch, and in ExploreResults render <ErrorMessage message=… onRetry={refetch}> (the primitive already supports onRetry) instead of EmptyResults.

summary: The 'For you' control is a single role="tab" in a role="tablist" that actually works as a disclosure. It sets aria-haspopup="dialog", but the panel it opens is an inline role="region", not a dialog, and nothing links the two with aria-controls. Screen readers announce 'tab, selected, has popup dialog' and get no dialog.
fix: Drop role=tablist/tab/aria-selected/aria-haspopup. Make it a plain disclosure <button aria-expanded={filterOpen} aria-controls={panelId}> and give FeedFilterPanel id={panelId}. If tabs return later, use <Tabs>/<Tab> from ui/tabs.tsx.

summary:
Each feed filter checkbox group ('Show activities from accounts that are endorsed by:', 'Activity quality', 'Organization quality') is titled by a plain

, so screen readers don't hear the group name when they move into the checkboxes. The checkboxes are also raw rather than the primitive the explore popovers use.
fix: Wrap each section in <fieldset> with a <legend className="feed-evaluator-panel__heading"> (or role="group" aria-labelledby), and render rows with <Checkbox label=…> from ui/checkbox.tsx.

summary: Home feed filter rows (.feed-evaluators__row) are about 20px tall (padding 2px, 16px checkbox) and have no mobile override. On a phone that's well under the 44px tap target this codebase enforces elsewhere (for example .home-row and .response-buttons__btn under max-width: 799px).
fix: Under @media (max-width: 799px) give .feed-evaluators__row a min-height of 44px. On desktop, .feed-evaluators__name also needs min-width: 0 so long names ellipsize instead of overflowing the flex row.

summary: The per-recipient write status (writing/success/failed) is a <span aria-label> with no role. aria-label is prohibited on generic spans and most screen readers ignore it, so the status icons are silent. The 'N of M endorsements written' summary (line 216) appears without a live region, so the batch result is never announced either.
fix: Give the status spans role="img" (keep aria-label) or add visually hidden text, and render .endorsement-multi-summary with role="status" (aria-live=polite).

summary: Interactive funding rows are role="button" with the fixed aria-label 'View funding receipt details'. The label replaces the row's own content, so every row sounds identical to a screen reader (no date, parties or amount). The role=button also contains nested links and buttons, which is invalid.
fix: Remove the role, tabIndex and aria-label from the <article>. Put a real <button> (for example a visually hidden or trailing 'Details' button named with the amount and date) inside the row to open the modal, and keep the row-level onClick as a mouse convenience.

summary: The 'New list name' <Input> in the Add-to-list dialog has only a placeholder for a label, so it loses its accessible name and visible label once the user types.
fix: Add aria-label="New list name" or a visible <label>. Also replace the raw '+ Create a new list' <button class=add-to-list__create-btn> (line 435) with <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">.

summary: Endorsement list errors render <ErrorMessage message={error} /> with no retry, even though the hook exposes refetch and ErrorMessage supports onRetry (same at line ~60 for the Given list). activity-detail-route.tsx:52 also passes the raw error string as the ErrorMessage title, so a technical message like 'Failed to fetch' becomes the heading.
fix: Pass onRetry={refetch} on both endorsements lists. In activity-detail-route, use a fixed title ('Couldn't load this activity'), put `error` in the message, and add onRetry.

summary: .explore-user-card:hover uses the ad-hoc shadow `box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg-primary) 6%, transparent)`, which breaks hard rule 4 (shadows must be --shadow-sm|md|lg).
fix: Use box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm).

summary: The 'New' endorsement action is a hand-rolled <button class="endorsements-new-btn"> with its own hover, disabled and 44px mobile CSS and a literal `transition: background 0.15s ease` (feed.css:802), instead of the <Button> primitive (hard rule 10).
fix: Use <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick=… disabled={!did}><Plus aria-hidden/> New</Button> (the aria-label can go, since the visible text plus the tab context is enough). Delete .endorsements-new-btn except align-self.

summary: Home feed and explore pass buttonClassName to <LoadMoreSentinel>, which uses its escape hatch to render a raw <button> styled by duplicated CSS (.home-feed__load-more-btn in home.css:712-749, .explore__load-more-btn in explore.css:463) instead of the primitive's default <Button>. The same applies at explore.tsx:1402.
fix: Drop buttonClassName at both call sites so the sentinel renders <Button variant="secondary">, then delete the two bespoke button rule sets.

summary: Hover tooltips on dates show the raw ISO string (for example '2026-10-22T14:03:11.123Z') via title={createdAt}. The same happens at activity-detail.tsx:1007, cert-detail-parts.tsx:397, funding-receipt-row.tsx:91, funding-receipt-detail-modal.tsx:556 and account-list-row.tsx:79 ('Joined 2026-…Z'). Endorsement rows already use a localized toLocaleString().
fix: Add a shared formatAbsoluteDateTime(iso) helper (Intl.DateTimeFormat with dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short') next to formatShortDate in lib/utils/format-date, and use it for every <time title>.

summary: <time> elements show relative text ('3h') with no dateTime attribute, so they aren't machine-readable: activity-card.tsx:88 and explore-list-row.tsx:166. explore-list-row also renders an empty <time></time> when timestampIso is null.
fix: Add dateTime={iso} (plus the absolute title from feed-17), and render the <time> only when timestampIso is present.

summary: The funding status notes ('Recording your funding — it will appear here shortly…' and 'Funding recorded. It is taking longer than usual…') appear after the modal closes, but they aren't in a live region, so screen-reader users get no confirmation that the funding was recorded.
fix: Add role="status" to both .funding-form__recorded-note paragraphs.

summary: Card and thumbnail images inside a link that also contains the visible title get descriptive alt text ('Image for {title}', 'Thumbnail for {title}' in home.tsx:302/353, '{title}' in activity-card.tsx:59), so screen readers read the title twice in the link name. Explore cards already use alt="" for the same layout.
fix: Use alt="" for these decorative thumbnails, since the adjacent title already names the link.

summary: The Plus Code copy button switches its visible text to 'Copied', but its static aria-label ('Copy Plus Code X') overrides that text, so screen readers never hear the confirmation. The same applies to the copy button in funding-receipt-detail-modal.tsx:601, where the label changes in place without a live region.
fix: Remove the static aria-label (the visible code text is enough, or use aria-describedby), or add a visually hidden role="status" span that announces 'Copied'.

summary: .cert-detail__map-expand-btn is 30x30 with no mobile 44px bump, unlike the other controls on the page. The leaflet toolbar does bump to 44px on mobile.
fix: Add @media (max-width: 799px) { .cert-detail__map-expand-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; } }, or let <Button size="icon"> handle sizing per feed-04.

summary: The active explore sidebar filter is shown only by the .explore__filter--active class. The button has no aria-current or aria-pressed, so assistive tech can't tell which filter is selected.
fix: Add aria-current={activeFilter === f.key ? "true" : undefined} (or aria-pressed) to both the standard and featured filter buttons.

summary: The category pill triggers pass aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded, but PopoverTrigger's cloneElement silently overrides both with aria-haspopup="menu". The props are dead and say the wrong popup type (also at line 1121).
fix: Remove the explicit aria-haspopup and aria-expanded from both pill buttons and let PopoverTrigger own them.

summary: feed.css has unused selectors that no TSX references: .create-form__input/__textarea (lines 26-47, the off-grid `padding: 12px 14px` §14.1 called out), .feed-filter* (156-195), .feed__load-more* (528-556, `transition: all`), .feed-evaluators__show-all* (329-342) and .profile-endorsements__endorse-btn*. They keep rule drift (literal 0.15s ease, transition: all) in grep results.
fix: Delete the unused rule blocks after a final grep across src (including dynamic className strings) confirms they're unused.

summary: The formatting bar is declared role="toolbar", but every button is its own tab stop and there's no arrow-key roving, which the toolbar pattern implies. Keyboard users have to tab through up to about 12 buttons to reach the editor body.
fix: Add roving tabindex (one button tabIndex=0, the rest -1, with Left/Right/Home/End moving focus), or drop role="toolbar" if roving isn't wanted.

summary: On the Received tab, .endorsement-row is a single non-wrapping flex row: 48px avatar, name, date, and the Accept and Reject buttons (each at least 44px tall with 14px padding on mobile). At 360-390px wide the name/handle column shrinks to a few characters. There's no max-width: 799px rule for .endorsement-row. Verify at 375px.
fix: Under @media (max-width: 799px), set flex-wrap: wrap on .endorsement-row and give the trailing .response-buttons margin-left: 60px (the avatar column) so the buttons drop below the identity.

summary: Neighbour avatars in the graph detail panel are <span title> around an <Avatar> with alt="" by default, so screen readers get no name (title isn't reliably announced). They also can't be focused or clicked to jump to that node.
fix: Pass alt={n.displayName || n.handle} to the Avatar, or better, make each one a <button aria-label={name} onClick={() => focusNode(n.id)}>.

summary: Zoom controls use text glyphs ('+', '−', '⤢') and three hand-inlined SVGs (fullscreen, chevron, external-link), while the rest of the app uses lucide icons at fixed sizes. The glyphs render at font-dependent sizes and weights.
fix: Use lucide Plus, Minus, Scan/Maximize2, Maximize/Minimize, ChevronDown and ArrowUpRight at size 16 and strokeWidth 1.75 to match the other icon buttons.

summary: Home feed, explore results, endorsements lists and the activity detail all load behind a centered spinner, though <Skeleton> and ActivityCardSkeleton exist. The spinner-to-content jump causes layout shift on the feed's main surface.
fix: Proposal: render 3-4 skeleton cards that match .home-feed__card (avatar circle, two text lines, 1:1 image box) for the initial feed load, and skeleton rows for endorsement lists.

summary: The feed empty states ('You're not following anyone yet', 'No activity yet') and the record 'Not found' page (src/app/[actor]/[type]/[rkey]/page.tsx:52) are dead ends with no next action. The follow-list error Banner says 'Please try again later' with no retry.
fix: Proposal: add an action (for example 'Explore accounts' linking to /explore?show=accounts) to the not-following empty state, 'Go to Explore' on Not found, and a Retry button on the follows error banner.

summary:
The endorsements empty states are bare

(a 240px centered muted line), while other surfaces use . The ConfirmDialog copy also mismatches: the title is 'Revoke endorsement' but the body says 'Do you really want to delete this endorsement?'.
fix: Proposal: use <EmptyState icon={Award} …> for both tabs, and change the dialog body to 'Revoke your endorsement of {name}? You can endorse them again later.'

summary: The home sidebar section headings (h2.home-section__title) are 0.7rem uppercase eyebrows, and the feed filter headings are 0.6875rem uppercase. Both are below the canonical type scale and read as microcopy. Hard rule 6 asks headings to use text-h* + font-headline, but these are deliberately eyebrow-style nav labels.
fix: Proposal: either keep the eyebrow style and demote the element to a non-heading label (with an aria-labelledby section), or move to a canonical small-heading token. This is an owner decision.
